Labels: bug, flaky-test, chore, feature.
Epics: E-ci, E-sync, E-ui.
Rule: a failure that disappears on rerun with no user-visible symptom is flaky-test, not bug.
Epic rule: a test that only fails in CI belongs to E-ci, whatever feature the test covers; E-sync owns only user-visible sync defects.
Issue: tests/test_sync.py::test_retry fails about 1 run in 8 on CI and passes locally and on rerun. Nobody has reported a sync problem in production.
